title: AI Builder — Working Student
description: <p><strong>EggAI Labs</strong> · Working Student · In Person (Tübingen, Germany)</p> <p class="code-line" data-line="4"><em>Designing lifecycle evaluation for nondeterministic domain-specific AI systems.</em></p> <h2 id="eggai-labs" class="code-line" data-line="6">EggAI Labs</h2> <p class="code-line" data-line="8">We're opening the EggAI Labs in Tübingen. The Labs purpose is to test new AI capabilities, identify what works, how they'd improve delivery, and then build assets to support teams and clients. EggAI's mission cannot be achieved through one-off client projects alone and the Labs is the way to adapt and scale.</p> <p class="code-line" data-line="10">As part of the first cohort, you will join a small peer group and work directly with EggAI's CAIO, a Tübingen alumnus. You will also collaborate with our engineering, product, and project leads, who will bring you insights from client problems, help you understand their context and challenge your solutions for them. Your fellow AI Builders will be deliberately chosen to span different passions and strenghts. You will have room to explore and be expected to turn that exploration into something useful. This is not a client-facing role.</p> <h2 id="the-problem-evalops" class="code-line" data-line="12">The problem: EvalOps</h2> <p class="code-line" data-line="13"><strong>How do we prove an AI system acts as expected under various conditions?</strong></p> <p class="code-line" data-line="15">We will explore&nbsp;<strong>EvalOps</strong>: the methods and tools used to check whether domain-specific AI systems meet their behavioral requirements. Among the key challenges for operating AI systems are nondeterminism, ground-truth curation, evaluation metric-design, latency and costs. EvalOps need to overcome all of them in a disciplined way.</p> <p class="code-line" data-line="17">These questions will guide the initial work:</p> <ul class="code-line" data-line="18"> <li class="code-line" data-line="18"><strong>Regression suites</strong>: How can domain experts turn traces, code, and prompts into useful evals in a way that scales?</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="19"><strong>Coverage estimation</strong>: How can we quantify the gaps between an eval suite and the range of expected agent behaviors?</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="20"><strong>Live monitoring</strong>: Is it possible to detect anomalous behaviour in production with a similar precision to regression evals?</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="21"><strong>Eval analysis</strong>: How much evidence is enough to act (e.g., deploy, debug, roll back a feature, choose a different model)? You will help refine them, test approaches, create assets, and pose new questions.</li> </ul> <h2 id="the-role" class="code-line" data-line="24">The role</h2> <p class="code-line" data-line="26">As an AI Builder, you will take an open EvalOps problem from investigation to a working prototype, ready to be tested. Whatever your focus, you will be expected to take a problem through to a useful result. Here is what that means in practice:</p> <ul class="code-line" data-line="27"> <li class="code-line" data-line="27">Research emerging AI and evaluation capabilities and distinguish substance from hype.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="28">Understand the user, workflow, domain, and organisational problem around the work.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="29">Evaluate usefulness, quality, safety, and reliability with appropriate evidence.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="30">Communicate decisions and learning clearly.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="31">Create assets that other people can understand, use, and improve.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="32">Code and build end to end.</li> </ul> <p class="code-line" data-line="34">This shared foundation leaves room for different strengths and interests. Each AI Builder will then develop greater depth in one of three pillars.</p> <h2 id="three-pillars-different-passions" class="code-line" data-line="36">Three pillars, different passions</h2> <table class="code-line" data-line="38"> <thead class="code-line" data-line="38"> <tr class="code-line" data-line="38"> <th style="text-align: left;">Pillar</th> <th style="text-align: left;">Driving question</th> <th style="text-align: left;">Possible EvalOps focus</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody class="code-line" data-line="40"> <tr class="code-line" data-line="40"> <td><strong>Product</strong></td> <td>What should we build?</td> <td>Workflows and interfaces that help domain experts create evals, inspect traces, understand results, and make decisions.</td> </tr> <tr class="code-line" data-line="41"> <td><strong>Engineering</strong></td> <td>How should we build it?</td> <td>Dependable and scalable evaluation infrastructure, trace processing, monitoring, and governance tooling.</td> </tr> <tr class="code-line" data-line="42"> <td><strong>Data Science</strong></td> <td>How do we know it works?</td> <td>Coverage measures, sampling strategies, scoring methods, statistical tests, anomaly detection, and reasoning under uncertainty.</td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <p class="code-line" data-line="45">We expect every AI Builder to develop a practical foundation across all three pillars and to pursue greater depth in the one that most strongly matches their passion.</p> <h2 id="what-we-value" class="code-line" data-line="45">What we value</h2> <ul class="code-line" data-line="46"> <li class="code-line" data-line="46"><strong>Problem obsession</strong>. A difficult question captures your curiosity. You keep returning to it, pursue ideas without waiting for instructions, and care deeply about finding an answer that works.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="47"><strong>Initiative and follow-through</strong>. You turn uncertainty into something you can investigate, test, and improve—and stay resourceful when the first approach fails.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="48"><strong>Evidence of making things work</strong>. Show us something you created, the decisions you made, and what you learned along the way.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="49"><strong>Independent judgment</strong>. You test new capabilities yourself, distinguish evidence from enthusiasm, and change your mind when the findings warrant it.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="50"><strong>Generosity in collaboration</strong>. You explain your thinking, seek candid feedback, act on it, and help others make progress.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h2 id="what-is-required" class="code-line" data-line="53">What is required</h2> <ul class="code-line" data-line="54"> <li class="code-line" data-line="54">You are pursuing a Master’s degree.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="55">You can write code and turn an idea into working, tested software.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="56">You can work from Tübingen and communicate fluently in English, our company language.</li> </ul> <p class="code-line" data-line="58">Relevant fields include Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Physics, Bioinformatics, Computational Neuroscience, Medical Informatics, Quantitative Data Science, Cognitive Science. We also welcome candidates from other disciplines who can demonstrate strong problem-solving and practical technical ability.</p> <h2 id="what-you-will-gain" class="code-line" data-line="60">What you will gain</h2> <ul class="code-line" data-line="61"> <li class="code-line" data-line="61"><strong>Industry insight</strong>. Learn what works and what breaks in real enterprise AI systems, with access to problems from EggAI’s client work</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="62"><strong>Meaningful ownership</strong>. Take an EvalOps problem from investigation to a working, evaluated solution, with freedom to shape the approach.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="63"><strong>Close mentorship</strong>. Work directly with EggAI’s Chief AI Officer and sharpen your judgment through feedback from engineering, product, and project leads.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="64"><strong>Room to develop</strong>. Deepen your strengths, learn from peers with complementary perspectives, and use modern AI-development tools on unresolved problems.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="65"><strong>A say in the Lab’s direction</strong>. Help establish its working practices, propose new questions, and influence what it pursues next.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="66"><strong>Competitive compensation</strong>, including recognition for exceptional contributions, and a potential path to a full-time EggAI role after graduation.</li> </ul> <h2>How to apply</h2> <p>A short cover letter is required.</p> <p>Your CV tells us&nbsp;<strong>what</strong> you have done so far, but we're also interested in the <strong>why</strong>. Use the letter to explain why you made those choices, what drives you, and why the AI Builder role at EggAI Labs feels like the right next step in your career.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are looking for exceptional students, and excellence takes many forms, e.g., academic results, research or ambitious projects. Whatever form yours takes, show us the appropriate evidence, be it grades, publications, something you've built or other evidence of impact.</p> <p>This is an in-person role in Tübingen. We can only consider candidates who live within commuting distance.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h1>About EggAI</h1> <p class="code-line" data-line="8"><strong>Agentic workforces are inevitable. We begin with the client problem, select the technical approach that best serves it, and remain accountable through deployment, adoption, and operations. Each deployment strengthens the next by turning production learning into reusable capability.</p> <p class="code-line" data-line="14">We are an experienced, international team working across Europe. We set high standards, take ownership of outcomes, and value clear thinking, candid feedback, and the ability to turn ideas into tangible results.</p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

This role can be office-based in Freiburg, Germany or remote-first, with a requirement to be in the office one full week per month.

About Black Forest Labs

We’re the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX—foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and video. We’re creating the generative models that power how people make images and video—tools used by millions of creators, developers, and businesses worldwide. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we’re just getting started.

Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we’re scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity.

Why This Role

Our models are already seeing strong inbound demand, and we’re expanding our commercial team to accelerate adoption across enterprise and strategic partners.

We’re looking for someone who can translate deep technical interest into durable, long-term partnerships  especially across complex, non-standard engagements involving APIs, on-prem deployments, and custom licensing.

This role owns the end-to-end commercial journey, working closely with research, engineering, and leadership to help customers move confidently from evaluation to production.

What You’ll Work On

  • Own the full sales cycle from discovery through close and expansion across startups, scaleups, and enterprises

  • Run complex, multi-stakeholder deals involving technical buyers, executives, and legal teams

  • Design and execute sales motions across APIs, on-prem deployments, and custom licensing

  • Build durable customer relationships that drive retention and long-term expansion

  • Partner closely with solutions engineering, forward-deployed engineers, product, research, and legal on bespoke deals

  • Translate customer needs and market signals into actionable feedback for product and research

  • Help define early commercial processes, playbooks, and qualification frameworks as we scale

What We’re Looking For

You’ve closed real, technically complex B2B deals and know how to operate without a playbook.

You bring strong judgment navigating long sales cycles, highly competitive environments with ambiguous requirements, and evolving products, and you’re comfortable working cross-functionally to get deals done the right way, not just quickly.

You'll likely have:

  • Experience selling technical products to tech executives, ML teams, and enterprise stakeholders

  • Ability to discuss model capabilities, inference requirements, and integration tradeoffs with technical buyers

  • Proven success managing long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and closing strategic landmark deals

  • Strong negotiation skills across pricing, licensing, and custom commercial terms

  • Track record building and scaling pipelines across different deal sizes and customer types

  • Comfort shaping process and structure in fast-moving, early-stage environments

How We Work Together

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. Depending on your role, you’ll either join us in Freiburg or SF at least 2 days a week (or one full week every other week), or work remotely with a monthly in-person week to stay connected. We’ll cover reasonable travel costs to make this possible. We think in-person time matters, and we’ve structured things to make it accessible to all. We’ll discuss what this will look like for the role during our interview process.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

  • Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.

EU €150,000 - €185,000 + variable + equity

US $180,000 - $210,000 USD + variable + equity

technical work streams from end-to-end, with the ability to effectively manage priorities, deliver on-time, and communicate effectively internally and with customers.</li> <li>Become a power-user of conducting Quarterly Business Reviews and leveraging data-driven insights to astonish our clients while promptly relaying valuable feedback to the appropriate Altana teams.</li> <li>Respond to user support queries and build processes that enable us to scale our TAM functions as our customer base increases.</li> <li>Be held accountable for effectively synthesising and communicating feedback to the product team.</li> <li>Coordinate the specification of new or expanded features, involving deep collaboration with Altana’s Product &amp; Engineering teams.</li> <li>Collaborate with our Implementation Engineering team to ensure successful delivery and work closely with our Sales Engineering team to identify and prioritise growth opportunities.</li> <li>Collaborate with Account Executives to identify and capitalise on expansion opportunities, transforming them into reality.</li> <li>Balance strategic thinking with tactical execution, connecting day-to-day account management with broader commercial and product goals.</li> <li>Grow to become an expert in how governments and enterprises can leverage technology to address supply chain risk, trade enforcement and trade facilitation use cases.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About You</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have 4-6 years of customer management, technology consulting, or general technology delivery experience, ideally some active clearance already.</li> <li>Nice to have: <ul> <li>An active UK Security Check (SC) clearance.</li> <li>Experience working with public sector customers in the UK and overseas.</li> languages.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p>This role is based in London with hybrid work flexibility and candidates must be within commuting distance from our Holborn office.</p> <p>The recruiter assigned We rely on each other to deliver, to speak openly, and to hold ourselves accountable.</li> <li><strong>Resilience: </strong>In a world of uncertainty and complexity, our work must withstand challenges, evolve with conditions, and ensure reliability over time. Resilience is both how we operate and what we deliver. It’s how we respond when things don’t go to plan –– we adapt, we support each other, and we keep moving forward.</li> <li><strong>Stewardship:</strong> We are stewards of every mission we touch. Each of us is personally responsible for fostering a workplace where people can thrive. And we are stewards of the greater good of the company. By holding ourselves and each other accountable, we build a culture of innovation and collective success that reflects the scale of our mission.</li> <li><strong>Courage: </strong>Courage is what unlocks the seemingly impossible for our customers. As an Account Executive at Altana Technologies, you'll be at the forefront of our sales initiatives, playing a crucial role in growing our footprint with Logistics Service Providers. You'll be working closely with various teams, including Account Management, Product Management, and Marketing to drive sales cycles and build new business pipelines.</p> <p>Your Responsibilities</p> <ul> <li>Develop detailed sales plans and sales forecasts</li> <li>Drive active sales cycles while building new business pipeline through prospecting and relationship building with mid-sized Logistics Service Providers</li> <li>Manage a large portfolio of Logistics Service Provider accounts from Ocean Liners to Customs Brokers.</li> <li>Summarize product feedback gathered from customer meetings and act as advocate for our customers with internal development and product teams</li> <li>Maintain up to date knowledge of logistics industry,</li> <li>Ability to sell across multiple Lines of Business simultaneously (IT, Procurement, Transportation, Supply Chain/Logistics),</li> <li>Travel to meet with clients, prospects and partners</li> </ul> <p>About You</p> <ul> <li>Experience working with a fast-growth technology company, strongly preferred</li> <li>5+ years of Enterprise Software sales experience is required</li> <li>Passionate about the supply-chain and logistics/transportation space.</li> <li>Excellent presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively to both technical and executive audiences, whether it's an impromptu whiteboard discussion or a prepared presentation and demo.</li> <li>Ability to be strategic, but still roll up your sleeves to accomplish what needs to be done</li> <li>Highly organized with a strong sense of urgency to meet deadlines</li> <li>Ability to operate in a rapidly-changing, fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with a cadence of delivering consistent results,</li> <li>Track record of carrying and delivering against an annual quota of $1M+</li> <li>Previous sales process &amp; methodology training</li> </ul> <p>This role is based in New York or the United Kingdom and candidates must be within commuting distance from our London office (UK) or New York office (US).</p> <p><strong>US Salary Range and Benefits</strong></p> <p>$100,000 - $155,000 USD</p> <p>The salary range, to the extent specified for this role, is a good faith statement of the minimum and maximum levels of the annual based salary for the position.&nbsp; The base salary offered to a successful candidate will depend on a wide range of compensation factors, including, but not limited to, work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Altana's total compensation package. Altana also offers either a discretionary bonus or a variable compensation plan depending on the role. Additionally, Altana offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:</p> <ul> <li>Flexible Time Off: Altana operates with a Flexible Time Oﬀ (FTO) policy that gives you agency over your own time oﬀ so you can maximize your work-life balance.</li> <li>Parental Leave: We oﬀer industry leading Paid Parental Leave (PPL), providing 14 weeks of leave for non-birthing, adoptive, and foster parents and up to 26 weeks of leave for birthing parents, all paid at 100% of your base salary.</li> <li>Health Benefits: We have a full suite of medical, vision, and dental benefits with generous employer contributions, designed to give you flexibility and choice for your individual health situation. Our high deductible health plan is 100% employer paid for employees and supplemented with an employer contribution to your Health Savings Account (HSA). There is also a Flexible Spending Account (FSA) option.</li> <li>Supplemental Benefits: Altana provides life, short- and long-term disability, and AD&amp;D insurance coverage, all at no cost to you, so you know that you and your loved ones are covered in case of an emergency.</li> <li>401(k) Savings: Save for and invest in your future using our Fidelity 401(k) retirement savings program.</li> <li>Commuter Benefits: Save money on your commute by setting aside pre-tax funds for public transit or parking!</li> <li>Wellness: Because we value mental and emotional health, every Altana employee has access to a free premium subscription to Calm, the #1 app for meditation, sleep, and mindfulness.</li> <li>Pet Insurance: Pets are family too! Keep them healthy with Wishbone insurance and / or our Total Pet vet service and telehealth discount plan.</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program: Free access to confidential personal support.</li> <li>Dependent Care FSA: You will have access to a Dependent Care FSA, which allows you to set aside pre-tax funds for childcare expenses</li> </ul> <p>The recruiter assigned to this role can share more information about the specific compensation and benefit details associated with this role during the hiring process.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>Our Values</strong></h3> <p>Our values are the core beliefs that shape who we are, what we stand for, and how we behave.They form the foundation of Altana’s culture and integrity and guide how we hire, design, build, and connect with each other and our customers.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Trust:</strong> Our customers and partners entrust us with missions of the highest importance. We honor that by keeping our word, meeting commitments, and ensuring every action we take reinforces confidence in us. We rely on each other to deliver, to speak openly, and to hold ourselves accountable.</li> <li><strong>Resilience: </strong>In a world of uncertainty and complexity, our work must withstand challenges, evolve with conditions, and ensure reliability over time. Resilience is both how we operate and what we deliver. It’s how we respond when things don’t go to plan –– we adapt, we support each other, and we keep moving forward.</li> <li><strong>Stewardship:</strong> We are stewards of every mission we touch. Because our work impacts lives and futures, we hold ourselves accountable to delivering mission impact and never compromising. Our responsibility extends beyond individual projects to the broader system of global trade. We believe that stewardship starts from within so that we can bring focus, creativity, and excellence to our work. Each of us is personally responsible for fostering a workplace where people can thrive. And we are stewards of the greater good of the company. By holding ourselves and each other accountable, we build a culture of innovation and collective success that reflects the scale of our mission.</li> <li><strong>Courage: </strong>Courage is what unlocks the seemingly impossible for our customers. It’s the core value that drives us make bold moves and take on big, complicated network problems—the ones others avoid. We know success isn't guaranteed, but we have the audacious vision to believe a solution is possible and to build it. Courage fuels our growth mindset. It means embracing challenges that make us stronger, and it’s demonstrated by how we approach hard conversations and complex projects.</li> </ul> <p>At Altana, we believe that a diverse workforce enables greater creativity, performance, and adaptability. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome you to join us as you are. Our employment opportunities and decisions are based on business needs and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, family care or medical leave status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by the laws or regulations in the areas in which we operate. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, in any situation.</p> <p><em>Offers related to employment at Altana will come from an Altana.ai email address. We will never ask for payment as part of the interview or onboarding process.&nbsp;</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

<h2><strong>Requirements</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Minimum of 7-8 years of professional experience with a minimum of 3-5 years of it spent in a security-related role</li> <li>Strong Experience with Python.</li> <li>Fluent English.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You might be a good fit if you</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Are excited about finding the right balance between security and velocity.&nbsp;</li> <li>Have opinions on how to secure agentic AI systems and want to put them into practice</li> <li>Enjoy helping other engineers understand and implement secure patterns.</li> <li>Are not afraid to take on complicated systems.</li> <li>Are excited to work on lots of different security-related work, from audits to code refactors.&nbsp;</li> <li>Work to make things easier for the next engineer who will touch your code.</li> <li>Always try to improve as a programmer and colleague.</li> <li>Are interested in building governance frameworks for AI usage in a regulated financial services environment</li> <li>Have experimented with LLM-based security tooling and understand both the promise and the failure modes</li> <li>Push through hard problems without giving up.</li> <li>Have description: <h3><strong>About Us</strong></h3> <p>We love going to work and think you should too. Our team is dedicated to trust, customer obsession, agility, and striving to be better everyday. These values serve as the foundation of our culture, guiding our actions and driving us towards excellence. We foster a culture of performance and recognition, allowing us to transform growth as we enable our employees to do the best work of their careers.</p> <p>LogicMonitor® is the AI-first hybrid observability platform powering the next generation of digital infrastructure. LogicMonitor delivers complete visibility and actionable intelligence across on-premises, cloud, and edge environments. By anticipating issues before they strike, optimizing resources in real time, and enabling faster, smarter decisions, LogicMonitor helps IT and business leaders protect margins, accelerate innovation, and deliver exceptional digital experiences without compromise.</p> <p>Our customers love LogicMonitor's ability to bring cloud and traditional IT together into one view, as seen in minimal churn rates, expansion business, and exciting new customer references. In fact, LogicMonitor has received the highest Net Promoter Score of any IT Infrastructure Management provider. LogicMonitor also boasts high employee satisfaction. We have been certified as a Great Place To Work®, and named one of BuiltIn's Best Places to Work for the seventh year in a row!&nbsp;</p> <p>To learn more about life at LogicMonitor, check out our <a href="https://www.logicmonitor.com/careers">Careers Page</a>.</p> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>AI Growth Strategists own the ongoing technical and business success of a portfolio of strategic Edwin AI customers. This is not a traditional Customer Success role and it is not a pure strategy or consulting role. The strategist sits between the customer’s technical environment, operational workflows and business priorities.</p> <p>Edwin AI operates across complex enterprise environments. Customer outcomes depend on observability and monitoring data, integrations, APIs, ITSM workflows, automation, cloud and infrastructure architecture, data quality and the way each customer operates. The strategist must be able to understand that environment, diagnose what is blocking adoption, bring the right technical resources together and maintain credibility with technical stakeholders.</p> <p>At the same time, the strategist must connect technical use cases and operational improvements to measurable business outcomes, executive priorities, retention and growth. You will work with technical practitioners, operational leaders and C-level stakeholders, moving comfortably between all three<strong>.</strong></p> <div data-hasbody="true" data-macro-name="panel"> <h3><strong>What You’ll Own</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the success of a portfolio of strategic and complex Edwin AI customers from post-implementation adoption through value realisation, maturity, advocacy and growth.</li> <li>Build a deep understanding of each customer’s architecture, observability environment, integrations, ITSM processes, operational workflows and AI use cases.</li> <li>Lead technical and operational discovery to understand customer requirements, diagnose adoption blockers and determine whether issues relate to configuration, integration, data, workflow, product capability or customer environment.</li> <li>Act as a credible technical partner to SRE, DevOps, platform, infrastructure, operations and engineering stakeholders while coordinating Support, Product and Engineering when deeper expertise is required.</li> <li>Translate technical capabilities, usage and operational outcomes into business value that is meaningful to CIOs, CTOs and other executive stakeholders.</li> <li>Develop and execute customer success and growth plans with clear use cases, success measures, adoption milestones, risks and value metrics.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to expand Edwin across additional teams, workflows and use cases based on demonstrated customer outcomes and technical fit.</li> <li>Represent the Voice of the Customer: investigate the underlying problem behind feature requests, quantify impact, identify patterns across customers and build evidence-based cases for Product and Engineering.</li> <li>Proactively manage customer risk and technical escalations, maintaining clear customer communication while driving internal ownership and resolution.</li> <li>Run executive and operational customer cadences that demonstrate adoption, measurable value, risks, priorities and next steps.</li> <li>Capture repeatable use cases, technical patterns, customer outcomes and lessons learned to improve team playbooks and product strategy.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Technical Expectations</strong></h3> <p>This role does not require you to be a software engineer, but it does require genuine technical depth. You should be able to enter an unfamiliar customer environment, ask the right questions, understand how systems connect, interpret technical evidence and narrow down where a problem is likely to sit.</p> <p>You should be comfortable discussing observability and monitoring concepts, APIs and integrations, ITSM workflows, cloud and infrastructure environments, automation, data flows and AI-driven operational use cases. You should know when you can progress the investigation yourself and when to bring in Support, Engineering or Product.</p> <p>You will be expected to learn Edwin AI deeply and maintain enough technical credibility that customers see you as part of the solution rather than simply a relationship manager.</p> <h3><strong>AI Mindset</strong></h3> <p>AI curiosity is essential. We want people who actively experiment with AI in their own work, not simply people who advise customers about it.</p> <p>You should be able to demonstrate how you use AI, agents, automation or emerging tools to improve your productivity, analyse information, create workflows or solve problems. description: <p><strong>Role:&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Software Engineer</strong><strong><br></strong><strong>Department: &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Engineering</strong><strong><br></strong><strong>Location:&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; UK - London </strong><br><strong>Reports into:&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Lead Software Engineer</strong><br><br></p> <p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>disguise is looking for a mid-level software engineer who considers themselves a generalist programmer. You will work in a small, highly focused team that is light on process and hands-on by default, writing software for demanding end users in situations where failure is visible to an audience of thousands.</p> <p>Our products design, sequence and control live productions across film and TV, broadcast, and live events. The code you write runs in front of an audience, often with no second take.</p> <p><strong>What you will do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own delivery of projects: customer projects, large features and internal tooling</li> <li>Build and help specify new features, working with Product to shape them</li> <li>Improve, support and maintain existing areas of the product</li> <li>Write testable, maintainable code, and the unit tests that prove it</li> <li>Debug methodically, using tools and logging to establish root cause rather than symptom</li> <li>Review the work of others constructively, explaining the reasoning behind a correction</li> <li>Work closely with Support so they understand issues in the codebase</li> <li>Share knowledge of your areas with the wider team</li> </ul> <p><strong>Essential experience we are looking for:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years experience writing C++ in a professional environment</li> <li>Experience releasing at least one commercial software product</li> <li>Experience working in a team to create code, review code and fix bugs</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirables:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Background in high performance, real-time systems</li> <li>Experience of Visual Studio, Python, Windows, DirectX</li> <li>Graphics development, Unreal Engine 5, or games industry experience</li> <li>Media server experience</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills, behaviour and values we are looking for:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>You will have clear communication, both verbal and written</li> </ul> <ul> <li>You will have excellent attention to detail, when writing and reviewing code</li> <li>You will enjoy problem solving complex issues with a curious and inquisitive mind</li> <li>You will be technically competent and interested in building out a product (ie, what the product should do, what else can make the product great)</li> <li>You will be collaborative, working with the team to build a product and knowledge share</li> <li>You will be pragmatic in the way you approach writing code</li> <li>You will be passionate to expand your knowledge&nbsp;</li> <li>You will have the resilience to keep experimenting</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Disguise</strong></p> <p>Disguise is the industry-leading platform sitting at the heart of a new era of visual experiences. One powerful integrated system of software, hardware and services to help create the next dimension of real-time spectacle.<br>We partner with the biggest entertainment brands and companies in the world to deliver the A-list of live music events, live TV broadcasts, immersive experiences, installations, theatre, film and TV production, corporate communications and brand product launches. Working with Disney, Snapchat, Netflix, ESPN, the Burj Khalifa, and Adele, Disguise is the number one partner delivering the next dimension of entertainment.&nbsp;</p> <p>Watch our <a href="https://vimeo.com/1152697197?fl=pl&amp;fe=sh">showreel</a></p> <p><strong><em>Don’t Disguise your differences.</em></strong></p> <p>Innovation comes from everyone. We strive to create a workplace that reflects our diverse audience. We celebrate our people for their full authentic selves, and embrace uniqueness. Inclusion and Equity matter at Disguise. We create together and we create everywhere.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Our values</strong></p> <ul> <li><em>Honest. We are real with ourselves and our clients and share our ideas with openness and transparency.&nbsp;</em></li> <li><em>Evolutionary. We innovate using our user’s ever-changing needs so our technology remains ahead-of-the-game.</em></li> <li><em>Fearless. We take the best path, not the easiest, and innovate where it’s right, not where it’s simplest.</em></li> <li><em>Resilience. We don’t give up until we find the right solution, even if it means going outside our remit.</em></li> <li><em>Belong.&nbsp; We create an environment where everyone feels like they belong and is empowered to do their best work.</em></li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Our benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>We have a suite of globally relevant competitive benefits packages as we want to make sure we retain the best talent out there. Our benefits for every perm hire, globally include:</li> <li>Unlimited Paid Time Off - with minimum time you must take set at 20% above statutory</li> <li>Hybrid working between home and our offices (dependent on role and location)</li> <li>Mental health and wellbeing support - subscription to the Calm app, mental health first-aid buddies, employee assistance programmes</li> <li>Gig allowance - £400 (or local equivalent) to spend on tickets every year to immerse yourself in our industries</li> <li>Belonging policies -&nbsp; including (but not limited to) support for Parental, Fertility, Miscarriage, Menopause and Transitioning</li> <li>Training, coaching &amp; mentoring</li> </ul></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <p><strong>Role: QA Engineer</strong></p> <p><strong>Department: QA</strong></p> <p><strong>Location: UK - London</strong></p> <p><strong>Reports into: Head of QA</strong></p> <h3><strong>About us:</strong></h3> <p>At Disguise, we are dedicated to providing innovative, reliable, and high-performance software and hardware solutions to our customers. As we continue to grow and innovate, we are looking to add a talented<strong> mid-level QA Engineer</strong> to our team. We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product engineers to own product areas within Doit's AI Stockbroking.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Engineer, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Founding lead Product Designer
description: Raison is on a mission to provide humans with better skills so they can feel confident and have more opportunities in the AI era. We help companies make sure 100% their teams master AI, directly in the flow of work (Teams, Slack) so that AI knowledge spreads across the organization instead of pooling in a handful of champions. We are passionate entrepreneurs believing that the ongoing AI revolution should be shared by all employees; and that the future of corporate interactions should not be restricted to private human-machine chats. Raison is capturing what champions create with AI, turning it into shared, governed skills, and propagating them so everyone feels capable and empowered; acting as a powerful lever to accelerate the AI transformation of corporates. We recently raised €2m from a top French VC + BPI and a selection of high-profile business angels who believe AI mastery is the highest-leverage application of AI inside companies. Tasks User Research & Discovery Own field research: contextual inquiry, user interviews, and observation of how teams actually work with AI and where it breaks. Build and maintain a deep understanding of our core users — individual contributors, champions, managers, and corporate buyers — and the context they operate in. Synthesize messy field data into sharp, actionable insight: jobs-to-be-done, adoption blockers, and the conditions under which a skill transfers between people. Establish a continuous discovery habit so research is a foundational reflex, and champion the user's perspective in every product decision. Product & Experience Design What our experts do by hand today is the spec for what the product must automate tomorrow. Your job is to watch that closely enough to design it. Design the surfaces: the client dashboard execs present to their board, the internal console our experts use to run a dozen live communities at once, and the conversations themselves. Most of our product lives inside someone else's client. You are designing in Teams and Slack, not screens we control — no onboarding, no landing page, no second chance. A four-minute message to an accountant who has never opened Copilot is the hardest design problem we have. Work mostly on enterprise, and partly on higher education, where we also have live deployments. Two audiences, two vocabularies, one product: part of your job is deciding what stays shared and what has to differ, so we build one coherent system rather than two half-products. Work hand-in-hand with our AI product engineers so your field learnings ship as features, then get re-tested at the next pilot. Own the design system: components, tokens, patterns, and the copy that goes with them. Requirements 4–8 years in product design, UX design, or a hybrid design-research role, ideally on complex, multi-user B2B products. A strong portfolio that shows both craft and thinking: we want to see how you operated, not just what shipped. A skilled researcher who can design a study, run it in the wild, and turn qualitative chaos into clear direction. Experience designing inside environments you don't control - a messaging client, an extension, an embedded product - or a clear appetite for it. Comfortable designing for AI-driven and adaptive experiences, where the interface has to handle uncertainty, personalization, and non-linear workflows. Excellent visual and interaction design skills: typography, spacing, motion, and the small details that build trust. Autonomous and opinionated, but you hold your opinions loosely when the evidence says otherwise. Genuine curiosity about AI and how people actually learn at work. Fluent in French and English, spoken and written. Spanish is a plus. You want the ownership, equity, and career-defining challenge that only comes from being early. Bonus: deeply passionate about something outside of work. Benefits A founding role with equity and direct influence on company strategy. Competitive salary, benchmarked to the Paris startup ecosystem. Flexibility: remote-friendly with regular in-person collaboration in Paris and an office in Montmartre with a beautiful Sacré-Coeur view. A front-row seat to one of the most important shifts in how humans learn. A small, sharp team that ships fast and trusts each other to figure things out. If you care deeply about making powerful tools feel human and want to shape a product from the very beginning, this is your role. Apply now and help us build the future of learning. title: Responsable Accompagnement Clients - Transition énergétique des bâtiments
description: Chez Lowit, nous avons une ambition : accélérer et massifier la transition énergétique des bâtiments tertiaires. Face à la hausse des coûts de l'énergie, aux enjeux climatiques et aux évolutions réglementaires, les gestionnaires de patrimoine ont besoin d'outils fiables, mais aussi d'un accompagnement de qualité pour passer à l'action. C'est pourquoi nous avons développé une plateforme SaaS qui permet de créer le jumeau numérique des bâtiments, de piloter les consommations énergétiques et de construire des trajectoires d'investissement réalistes, chiffrées et adaptées aux enjeux de chaque organisation. Aujourd'hui, nous accompagnons plusieurs centaines de collectivités et d'entreprises partout en France dans leurs projets de transition énergétique. PME lyonnaise en forte croissance, nous recherchons des collaborateurs qui souhaitent avoir un impact concret, prendre des responsabilités et contribuer à une aventure collective porteuse de sens. Vos missions Chez Lowit, nous accompagnons chaque jour des collectivités, des entreprises et des établissements publics dans la gestion et la transition énergétique de leur patrimoine immobilier. Notre plateforme leur permet de mieux connaître leurs bâtiments, de piloter leurs consommations, d'anticiper les obligations réglementaires et de construire des trajectoires d'investissement cohérentes. Parce qu'une plateforme ne crée de valeur que lorsqu'elle est pleinement appropriée par ses utilisateurs, nous accordons une place essentielle à l'accompagnement de nos clients. C'est précisément la mission de notre équipe Accompagnement Clients. Pour accompagner notre croissance, nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Responsable Accompagnement Clients . Vous deviendrez l'interlocuteur privilégié d'un portefeuille de collectivités, d'entreprises et d'établissements publics. Votre mission sera de construire une relation de confiance durable avec vos clients, de comprendre leurs enjeux et de les accompagner dans l'utilisation de nos solutions afin qu'ils en tirent le meilleur parti. Concrètement, vous serez amené à : Accompagner vos clients tout au long de leur parcours chez Lowit au travers d'échanges réguliers (téléphone, visioconférences, réunions et e-mails). Développer une compréhension approfondie de leurs enjeux afin de leur apporter un accompagnement pertinent et personnalisé. Les conseiller sur les sujets liés à la transition énergétique des bâtiments : réglementation, stratégie patrimoniale, performance énergétique, dispositifs d'aides, mécanismes de financement... en vous appuyant sur les experts internes lorsque cela est nécessaire. Réaliser ponctuellement des missions de conseil directement chez les clients afin de fiabiliser leur patrimoine, mettre à jour leurs données, construire des scénarios personnalisés et restituer des plans d'action auprès de leurs équipes de direction ou de leurs élus. Identifier les besoins émergents, détecter les opportunités d'accompagnement complémentaires et remonter les signaux business aux équipes concernées. Animer des webinaires, partager les bonnes pratiques et contribuer au développement de la communauté d'utilisateurs Lowit. Faire remonter les retours clients et les besoins fonctionnels afin de contribuer à l'amélioration continue de notre plateforme et de nos services. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Projets, Produit, Commerce et nos experts techniques afin de garantir un accompagnement de grande qualité. Ce poste est avant tout un métier de relation client, de conseil et d'accompagnement . Vous ne serez pas seul face aux problématiques techniques : vous pourrez vous appuyer sur les expertises présentes chez Lowit. En revanche, votre capacité à écouter, comprendre les enjeux de vos clients et construire avec eux une relation de confiance sera déterminante dans leur réussite… et dans la nôtre. Vos compétences Nous recherchons avant tout une personne qui aime construire des relations de confiance dans la durée. Ingénieur(e) de formation ou diplômé(e) d'un Bac+5 dans les domaines de l'énergie, du bâtiment, de la thermique ou de l'immobilier, vous souhaitez mettre votre expertise au service de l'accompagnement client. Vous aimez comprendre les problématiques de vos interlocuteurs, les accompagner dans leurs projets et leur apporter des conseils concrets. Curieux(se), à l'écoute et pédagogue, vous appréciez autant les échanges humains que les sujets techniques. Une première expérience dans le conseil, la gestion de projet, le Customer Success ou l'accompagnement client constitue un véritable atout. Au-delà de votre parcours, nous serons particulièrement attentifs à votre capacité à : Créer une relation de confiance avec vos clients et communiquer avec aisance, aussi bien à l'oral qu'à l'écrit. Comprendre les enjeux techniques, réglementaires et patrimoniaux liés à la transition énergétique des bâtiments, ou avoir l'envie de développer rapidement cette expertise. Faire preuve de curiosité et d'une réelle envie d'apprendre dans un secteur en constante évolution. Organiser votre activité et prioriser efficacement les sollicitations d'un portefeuille clients. Travailler en équipe et mobiliser les bonnes expertises internes lorsque la situation l'exige. Être à l'aise avec les outils numériques et les environnements SaaS. Une connaissance des secteurs de l'énergie, du bâtiment, de l'immobilier ou des collectivités territoriales sera appréciée. Enfin, si vous aimez décrocher votre téléphone pour échanger avec vos clients, créer une relation durable et les accompagner bien au-delà de la simple utilisation d'un logiciel, vous vous sentirez probablement à votre place chez Lowit. Avantages Gratification : à définir en fonction de l’expérience Localisation : Quartier de la Part-Dieu, au cœur de Lyon Un environnement de travail jeune et dynamique Remboursement à 50% des transports en commun Tickets restaurant (10€/jour) Processus de recrutement rapide : 1 RDV visio pour faire connaissance + 1 RDV présentiel ou visio avec un fondateur suivi d’une décision Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Engineering Delivery & Operations Manager
description: Joining Weezevent means working on tangible solutions used at international festivals (Hellfest, Boomtown, Tomorrowland, Lollapalooza, Boom), major sporting events (Formula 1, the Olympic Games, Euro fan zones), and high-volume live experiences. Weezevent builds the technology behind live events: ticketing , cashless payment , CRM , staff solutions and access control . We are about 100 people in the tech team (engineering and product organisation), part of a group that has grown both organically and through acquisitions, so our teams span several countries and cultures. We are at an inflection point. We are opening a focused 12–18 month window to invest heavily in the foundations of our main product, WeezTicket: paying down technical debt, tightening our architecture, and setting ourselves up for the next phase of growth. To run that program, we’re hiring an Engineering Delivery & Operations Manager (M/F, based in Clichy) to own its delivery. Vos missions This is a two-part role, and the first part is where you’ll spend most of your first year. Part one : deliver the program . A board of our most experienced engineers is defining the architectural direction and producing a large backlog of clean-up and improvement work. That work will be delivered by several external squads brought in for the program. You own the delivery layer between them: getting squads stood up and productive on time, tracking each one’s pace and quality, and keeping the whole program on schedule. Stand up and onboard external squads, around 20 developers across 5 to 6 squads, on time : access, environments, documentation, and a well-scoped first backlog ready before they start Track the delivery pace of each squad against its commitments, and keep a clear program-level view of what’s on track, slipping, or blocked Hold squads to the quality bar set by the architectural board : tests, reviews, and no new debt introduced while removing old debt Manage cross-squad dependencies so work lands in the right order Track program spend against budget and manage the relationships with the partners supplying the squads Report program status to the CTO and the board on a regular cadence Part two : become the operational backbone of engineering. raw.title: Engineering Delivery & Operations Manager
raw.description:
Joining Weezevent means working on tangible solutions used at international festivals (Hellfest, Boomtown, Tomorrowland, Lollapalooza, Boom), major sporting events (Formula 1, the Olympic Games, Euro fan zones), and high-volume live experiences.

Weezevent builds the technology behind live events: ticketing, cashless payment, CRM, staff solutions and access control. We are about 100 people in the tech team (engineering and product organisation), part of a group that has grown both organically and through acquisitions, so our teams span several countries and cultures.

We are at an inflection point. We are opening a focused 12–18 month window to invest heavily in the foundations of our main product, WeezTicket: paying down technical debt, tightening our architecture, and setting ourselves up for the next phase of growth. To run that program, we’re hiring an Engineering Delivery & Operations Manager (M/F, based in Clichy) to own its delivery.

Vos missions

This is a two-part role, and the first part is where you’ll spend most of your first year.

Part one : deliver the program. A board of our most experienced engineers is defining the architectural direction and producing a large backlog of clean-up and improvement work. That work will be delivered by several external squads brought in for the program. You own the delivery layer between them: getting squads stood up and productive on time, tracking each one’s pace and quality, and keeping the whole program on schedule.

  • Stand up and onboard external squads, around 20 developers across 5 to 6 squads, on time : access, environments, documentation, and a well-scoped first backlog ready before they start
  • Track the delivery pace of each squad against its commitments, and keep a clear program-level view of what’s on track, slipping, or blocked
  • Hold squads to the quality bar set by the architectural board : tests, reviews, and no new debt introduced while removing old debt
  • Manage cross-squad dependencies so work lands in the right order
  • Track program spend against budget and manage the relationships with the partners supplying the squads
  • Report program status to the CTO and the board on a regular cadence

Part two : become the operational backbone of engineering. As the program matures, you’ll take on the people-operations side of the organisation: helping our managers run great 1:1s and reviews, coordinating the performance cycle, keeping an eye on team capacity and wellbeing, and bringing rigour to tooling and budget. This is what makes the role a long-term home rather than a temporary program job.

You’ll work closely with the CTO, the architectural board, our 4 Team Leads, and the external partners supplying the squads. You won’t set the technical strategy or write the code, you’ll make sure the right work gets delivered, on time, at the right quality.

  • Help 4 Team Leads and 6 Squad Leads run consistent 1:1s and grow as managers
  • Coordinate the performance review cycle and make sure follow-up actions actually happen
  • Keep visibility on team capacity, absences, and early signals of overload or burnout
  • Bring structure to tech budget tracking and to the governance of our tools and licences
  • Support hiring and internal mobility alongside our recruitment team

Vos compétences

Must-haves

  • Experience running a multi-squad delivery program end to end: ideally involving external agencies, consultancies, or contract teams
  • A track record of onboarding external teams onto an existing codebase and getting them productive quickly
  • Comfort owning a backlog, a schedule, and a budget across several parallel workstreams at once
  • The ability to track pace and quality per team and raise problems early, with data
  • Genuine tech literacy: you understand what developers do, can navigate a Jira board, and know what technical debt actually means
  • Fluent French and English

What makes you a strong long-term fit

  • Some experience coaching or supporting managers, or running a performance cycle in a tech company
  • A background that touched engineering, delivery, project management, or product before moving toward operations
  • Analytical rigour: you’re comfortable with numbers, dashboards, and cost reports
  • Direct, honest communication and real discretion with sensitive information

Nice to have

  • A third language (German or Dutch is a real plus given our footprint)
  • Experience working across France, the UK, the Netherlands, or Germany, and an understanding of how management styles differ across them

This is not

  • A role that sets architecture or writes code; that’s the board and the squads
  • A pure recruiter or a corporate-HR profile with no delivery or engineering exposure
  • A process-for-process’s-sake job. We want impact, not bureaucracy

The recruitment process

  • HR interview - background and soft skills
  • Interview with CTO - technical discussion

All our positions are open to people with disabilities.

Why it's a good move

You’ll run a high-visibility program with the direct backing of the CTO and the most senior engineers in the company, in an organisation that has decided to genuinely invest in its technical foundations rather than just talk about it. And when the program lands, you’ll have built yourself a permanent, central role at the heart of how our engineering organisation runs.

Askara est une start-up SaaS en forte croissance qui développe un logiciel basé sur l'intelligence artificielle et piloté à la voix pour les dentistes.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 4 000 praticiens utilisent notre solution, nous avons généré plus de 400 000 documents, et nous traitons plusieurs dizaines de milliers d'heures d'audio chaque mois.

Nous avons une équipe qui écoute les besoins des praticiens et construit le produit. Il nous manque la personne dont le métier est de le faire tourner.

Vos missions

Nous recherchons un(e) Technical Operations Engineer (TechOps), dont la mission tient en une phrase : Askara marche, de façon fiable et sûre.

Concrètement, vous prenez la responsabilité de tout ce qui fait qu'un produit livré reste un produit qui fonctionne : la sécurité, l'IT interne, la qualité et les tests, la réponse aux incidents.

Ce poste est une création. Aujourd'hui, ces sujets sont portés par le CTO, en parallèle du reste. Vous n'héritez donc pas d'une page blanche (ISO 27001 obtenue, EDR déployé, CI/CD en place, tests Playwright, monitoring Sentry, procédure d'incident formalisée) mais d'un périmètre réel, éclaté, qui n'a jamais eu de propriétaire à plein temps.

Vous serez le pivot entre :

  • la tech
  • le support
  • la conformité
  • la direction

Un mot d'honnêteté sur la nature du poste : c'est un rôle très opérationnel et très interne. On y écrit des procédures, mais surtout on les applique. On y rédige un plan de test, puis on le joue. On y documente une politique d'accès, puis on va révoquer les comptes un par un. Si vous cherchez un poste de méthodologie pure, ce n'est pas celui-là. Si vous aimez que les choses soient carrées et que ça se voie, c'est exactement celui-là.

🧪 Qualité produit et tests

(environ 40% du temps)

  • Prendre la stratégie de test de bout en bout : plans de test, tests automatisés (Playwright), smoke tests, tests de non-régression
  • Définir les critères de sortie d'une release : ce qui bloque un déploiement, ce qui ne le bloque pas
  • Jouer la QA sur les parcours critiques avant chaque livraison web, desktop et mobile

🚨 Fiabilité et incidents

(environ 30% du temps)

  • Faire vivre la procédure d'incidents : niveaux de gravité, playbooks, status page, communication client
  • Être Incident Lead sur les cas sérieux, et garantir que l'information circule vite et juste
  • Animer les post-mortems sans recherche de coupable, et surtout s'assurer que les actions correctives sont livrées
  • Entretenir le monitoring et l'alerting

🔐 Cybersécurité opérationnelle

(environ 20% du temps)

  • Faire vivre au quotidien notre dispositif de sécurité : EDR, MFA, gestion des vulnérabilités, durcissement des postes
  • Piloter les revues d'accès périodiques et en produire les preuves
  • Organiser la sensibilisation de l'équipe : campagnes de phishing, rappels, formation à l'arrivée

🖥️ IT interne et parc

  • Administrer les comptes et les accès sur l'ensemble de nos outils : SSO, MFA, gestionnaire de mots de passe, droits par rôle

🛠️ Environnement

  • Cloud : AWS, Terraform
  • Produit : application web (React), API (PHP / Symfony), Electron (Windows / macOS)
  • Tests : Playwright, CI GitHub
  • Monitoring : Sentry, UptimeRobot
  • Data / BI : Metabase, SQL
  • Suivi et doc : Linear, Notion, Slack

  • IA : Claude, agents et automatisations internes (MCP, scripts)

title: Product manager - gestion des projets (CDI)
description: 🧱 À propos de Bricks Chez Bricks, on construit la façon la plus simple d’investir dans l’immobilier, à partir de 10 €. 670 000+ membres, un produit régulé (PSFP) et une même exigence sur toute l’expérience : permettre d’investir simplement mais aussi de suivre son investissement dans la durée. Bricks est une plateforme à deux faces : d’un côté les investisseurs , de l’autre les porteurs de projets immobiliers . Deux communautés à accompagner et faire grandir en parallèle. Ce qui se passe après le financement d’un projet compte donc autant que le moment où l’on investit : qualité de l’information, transparence, suivi des projets et gestion des situations plus complexes participent directement à l’expérience des deux côtés de la plateforme. Quelques jalons d’une aventure assez unique : passage chez Capital (M6) en 2022, Tony Parker investisseur et ambassadeur, record européen de vitesse de levée : 5 M€ en 5 secondes, 20 M€+ en 10 jours auprès de notre communauté. Côté business : 176 M€ collectés en 2025, +90 % en un an et la rentabilité atteinte. Notre prochain enjeu : scaler à grande échelle sans perdre la vélocité qui fait aujourd’hui partie de notre manière de travailler. Chez Bricks, on attend de chacun qu’il comprenne vraiment les problèmes avant de chercher à les résoudre. L’objectif : prendre les bonnes décisions et construire des solutions utiles. Sur ce poste, ton travail aura un impact direct sur la qualité du suivi des projets et sur la confiance des investisseurs comme des porteurs de projets. Vos missions 🧩 Le job Tu rejoins la squad gestion des projets qui est en charge de tout ce qui se passe après le financement d’un projet immobilier. Aujourd’hui, Bricks gère environ 400 projets financés simultanément . Pour chacun d’eux, il faut suivre ce qui se passe sur le terrain : récupérer les bonnes informations auprès des porteurs de projets, communiquer régulièrement avec les investisseurs et lorsque quelque chose se passe moins bien, il faut savoir gérer les impayés, les pénalités et les éventuelles procédures de contentieux. C’est aussi ce qui fait de la gestion post-financement l’un des sujets les plus stratégiques pour Bricks . Une plateforme d’investissement ne se construit pas uniquement au moment où un utilisateur décide d’investir : elle se construit dans la durée, dans la qualité du suivi et dans la façon dont les situations plus complexes sont prises en charge. Le challenge n’est pas simplement de “gérer 400 projets”. Il est de construire un système capable d’en gérer demain beaucoup plus sans faire grossir l’équipe au même rythme. Une plateforme existe déjà et accompagne l’équipe au quotidien. Elle a atteint un niveau de maturité où les prochains problèmes ne se résoudront pas uniquement avec de nouvelles features : parfois la meilleure réponse sera produit, parfois process, parfois automatisation, parfois juridique. C’est là que tu interviens. 👉 Ce que tu vas owner Comprendre profondément le quotidien des utilisateurs internes en particulier celui de la personne qui opère nos projets au quotidien : observer, écouter, identifier les irritants et comprendre ce qui peut être supprimé, automatisé ou mieux structuré. Faire évoluer la gestion de plusieurs centaines de projets pour qu’elle reste fluide et scalable : priorisation, automatisation, workflows, process et outils. Travailler avec l’engineering pour transformer les problèmes identifiés en solutions produit lorsqu’une solution technique est pertinente. Aller chercher l’information là où elle se trouve : care, juridique, marketing, métier, engineering… Tu ne travailles pas à partir d’une spec parfaite, tu reconstruis toi-même le contexte. T’approprier des sujets parfois complexes ou réglementaires. Tu n’as pas besoin d’être juriste, mais un contrat de 50 pages ou une discussion sur un process de contentieux ne doit pas te faire fuir. Choisir le bon levier plutôt que la feature par défaut : modifier un process peut parfois avoir plus d’impact que développer un nouvel écran. Transformer chaque problème rencontré en apprentissage réutilisable : l’objectif n’est pas de traiter le problème du projet n°237, mais de faire en sorte qu’il soit mieux géré pour les centaines de projets suivants. Et progressivement, prendre de plus en plus d’ownership sur la stratégie et la roadmap de la squad . Le périmètre pourra évoluer fortement selon ce que tu démontres sur le terrain. 👥 La squad Tu travailleras au quotidien avec les équipes en charge du suivi opérationnel des projets ainsi qu’avec l'Engineering, le Product, le Growth et Marketing. Selon les sujets, tu seras également amené à collaborer avec le Care, le juridique ou la direction. Un même problème peut avoir des conséquences très différentes selon les équipes et les utilisateurs concernés. C’est un rôle où la collaboration compte énormément. Ton travail ne consiste pas simplement à recueillir les besoins de chacun et à les transformer en features. Tu dois aller chercher l’information directement auprès des personnes concernées, comprendre leur réalité opérationnelle, croiser les différents points de vue et remonter à la vraie problématique derrière une demande. Ce qu’un utilisateur te demande n’est pas toujours la solution dont il a besoin. À toi d’agréger le contexte, de challenger les demandes et de construire avec l’équipe la réponse la plus efficace qu’elle soit produit, process, technique ou juridique. Vos compétences 🎯 Tu fitteras si Tu as au moins 3 ans d’expérience en Product Management avec déjà une vraie autonomie sur ton périmètre. Tu as déjà travaillé sur un produit ou un environnement où il fallait comprendre le métier avant de construire la solution . Tu vas spontanément parler aux utilisateurs plutôt que d’attendre qu’un besoin parfaitement formulé arrive jusqu’à toi. C’est un point particulièrement important pour ce rôle. Tu es à l’aise dans des environnements mouvants. Tu peux passer plusieurs jours à creuser un problème complexe, puis devoir jongler entre plusieurs sujets dans la même journée. Tu sais récupérer rapidement le contexte, identifier ce qui compte et avancer sans te perdre dans l’information Tu as un vrai mindset builder/entrepreneur : tu n’as pas besoin que tout soit déjà structuré pour commencer à avancer. Tu sais travailler avec des experts sans avoir besoin de devenir toi-même expert de chaque sujet. Tu peux échanger avec un juriste, un développeur, le care ou le marketing, absorber leur contexte et transformer tout ça en décisions produit cohérentes. Tu sais défendre un point de vue et challenger quand c’est nécessaire y compris face à des interlocuteurs très seniors, tout en étant capable de changer d’avis quand les arguments sont meilleurs. Une expérience dans un environnement régulé ou à fortes contraintes métier : fintech, legaltech, comptabilité, RH… est un vrai plus. Ici une décision produit peut avoir des conséquences financières, juridiques ou opérationnelles réelles. Tu préfères faire beaucoup avec une petite équipe plutôt que de construire du process pour construire du process ❌ Tu ne fitteras probablement pas si Tu as besoin d’un framework très établi pour fonctionner. Tu attends des specs détaillées avant d’aller chercher toi-même le contexte. Ton premier réflexe face à un problème est systématiquement de créer une feature. Tu cherches à appliquer « la bonne méthode produit » indépendamment du contexte. Tu préfères passer trois semaines à cadrer parfaitement un sujet plutôt que tester rapidement une hypothèse lorsque le risque le permet. Ou tu imagines le rôle de PM comme quelqu’un qui organise le travail d’une squad depuis Jira : ici le Product Manager met vraiment les mains dans le problème . Avantages 🚀 Pourquoi ce rôle est intéressant La squad est déjà l’une des plus matures chez Bricks mais le terrain de jeu devant elle reste énorme. Aujourd’hui, il y a environ 400 projets. Demain, il peut y en avoir 2 000 avec de nouvelles typologies de produits, de nouveaux pays et de nouveaux enjeux réglementaires ou opérationnels. L’objectif n’est pas de construire une organisation lourde pour absorber cette croissance mais bien de trouver une meilleure façon de travailler à chaque étape . Et à mesure que tu prends ownership du sujet, ton rôle pourra aller bien au-delà de l’exécution d’une roadmap : comprendre suffisamment bien le métier pour contribuer directement aux prochains sujets sur lesquels Bricks doit investir. L'offre 👉 CDI, temps plein. 👉 De vrais sujets, un vrai impact : produit régulé, vraies conséquences quand on se plante. 👉 Beaucoup d’ownership : tu travailleras directement avec les personnes qui font le produit et tu auras une vraie influence sur ce qu’on construit. 👉Une boîte ambitieuse, rentable et en forte croissance : tu arrives à un moment où l’organisation Product est encore suffisamment petite pour que tu puisses réellement contribuer à la construire. 👉 Salaire compétitif, assurance santé moderne, MacBook Pro de ton choix, tout le matériel qu'il te faut. 👉 Hybride Montpellier : office-first (2j/sem de remote) ou remote-first (~2j/mois au bureau). Selon les sujets, tu seras également amené à collaborer avec le Care, le juridique ou la direction. Un même problème peut avoir des conséquences très différentes selon les équipes et les utilisateurs concernés.

C’est un rôle où la collaboration compte énormément. Ton travail ne consiste pas simplement à recueillir les besoins de chacun et à les transformer en features.

Tu dois aller chercher l’information directement auprès des personnes concernées, comprendre leur réalité opérationnelle, croiser les différents points de vue et remonter à la vraie problématique derrière une demande.

Ce qu’un utilisateur te demande n’est pas toujours la solution dont il a besoin. À toi d’agréger le contexte, de challenger les demandes et de construire avec l’équipe la réponse la plus efficace qu’elle soit produit, process, technique ou juridique.

🎯 Tu fitteras si

Tu vas spontanément parler aux utilisateurs plutôt que d’attendre qu’un besoin parfaitement formulé arrive jusqu’à toi. C’est un point particulièrement important pour ce rôle.
  • Tu es à l’aise dans des environnements mouvants. Tu peux passer plusieurs jours à creuser un problème complexe, puis devoir jongler entre plusieurs sujets dans la même journée. Tu sais récupérer rapidement le contexte, identifier ce qui compte et avancer sans te perdre dans l’information
  • Tu as un vrai mindset builder/entrepreneur : tu n’as pas besoin que tout soit déjà structuré pour commencer à avancer.
  • Tu sais travailler avec des experts sans avoir besoin de devenir toi-même expert de chaque sujet. Tu peux échanger avec un juriste, un développeur, le care ou le marketing, absorber leur contexte et transformer tout ça en décisions produit cohérentes.
  • Tu sais défendre un point de vue et challenger quand c’est nécessaire y compris face à des interlocuteurs très seniors, tout en étant capable de changer d’avis quand les arguments sont meilleurs.
  • Une expérience dans un environnement régulé ou à fortes contraintes métier : fintech, legaltech, comptabilité, RH… est un vrai plus. Ici une décision produit peut avoir des conséquences financières, juridiques ou opérationnelles réelles.
  • Tu préfères faire beaucoup avec une petite équipe plutôt que de construire du process pour construire du process

❌ Tu ne fitteras probablement pas si

  • Tu attends des specs détaillées avant d’aller chercher toi-même le contexte.
  • Ton premier réflexe face à un problème est systématiquement de créer une feature.
  • Tu cherches à appliquer « la bonne méthode produit » indépendamment du contexte.
  • Tu préfères passer trois semaines à cadrer parfaitement un sujet plutôt que tester rapidement une hypothèse lorsque le risque le permet.
  • Ou tu imagines le rôle de PM comme quelqu’un qui organise le travail d’une squad depuis Jira : ici le Product Manager met vraiment les mains dans le problème.

La squad est déjà l’une des plus matures chez Bricks mais le terrain de jeu devant elle reste énorme.

Aujourd’hui, il y a environ 400 projets. Demain, il peut y en avoir 2 000 avec de nouvelles typologies de produits, de nouveaux pays et de nouveaux enjeux réglementaires ou opérationnels. L’objectif n’est pas de construire une organisation lourde pour absorber cette croissance mais bien de trouver une meilleure façon de travailler à chaque étape.

Et à mesure que tu prends ownership du sujet, ton rôle pourra aller bien au-delà de l’exécution d’une roadmap : comprendre suffisamment bien le métier pour contribuer directement aux prochains sujets sur lesquels Bricks doit investir.
